statement: Assemble a virtual cell from a robot, tool, work reference, environmental parts, controller and signals with an alias matching the real machine.

acceptance.tolerance: All dependent targets update to <= 0.01 mm of rigid transform

acceptance.corpus: Robot on linear track following a 6 m line

statement: Create named Cartesian or joint targets from planes and show their orientation and name in the viewport.

acceptance.corpus: 100 targets from curve frames with names

superiority: Toolpath history with undo and non-destructive edits.

acceptance.tolerance: Target order and attributes match the expected sequence

statement: Declare digital and analog signals and drive them from procedure steps such as waits and conditional logic, mapped to the controller's indices on export.

acceptance.tolerance: All indices correct on export for ABB and UR

statement: Build procedures with branching, loops and custom controller code for processes that go beyond simple point-to-point motion.

acceptance.corpus: Procedure with nested loop of 5x10 targets and a conditional
acceptance.tolerance: Simulated step order equals expected sequence of 50 targets

statement: Show approximation zones, interpolation, digital output values, tool and part simulation and material stock removal during preview.
superiority: GPU boolean-free stock preview at interactive rate.

acceptance.corpus: Milling toolpath over 100 mm cube stock, 20,000 moves
acceptance.tolerance: Stock volume removed within 1% of analytic sweep; >= 30 fps

statement: Simulate trajectories accurately and diagnose out-of-reach and singular positions before export.
superiority: Highlight the exact segment and cause, and propose joint-limit-safe alternatives.

acceptance.corpus: Path with 10 seeded singularities and 8 unreachable targets
acceptance.tolerance: All 18 found; no false positives on clean targets

acceptance.tolerance: Zero parse errors; poses within 0.001 mm

acceptance.tolerance: Equal TCP poses in all outputs within 0.01 mm
